attributes.name: Cultist Archer
attributes.powers:
Before you act, succeed at a Wisdom or Perception 9 check or the Cultist Archer deals 1d4-1 Ranged Combat damage to you.

If undefeated, search the blessings deck until you find a blessing and shuffle it into your location deck.

Zealously devoted to his demonic patron, the cultist archer shoots down foes by direct order.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Cultist Archer, change "If undefeated, shuffle the top card of the blessings deck into your location deck" to "If undefeated, search the blessings deck until you find a blessing and shuffle it into your location deck".
corrections.issue: If I fail to defeat a Cultist Archer, and the top card of the blessings deck is not a blessing, do I shuffle it into my location deck?
